name: Alphanumeric SKU Matching with Punctuation & Case Invariance
description: Customers search for model numbers in messy formats: 'wh-1000xm5', 'WH1000-XM5', 'wh 1000 xm5'. Robust search normalizes punctuation and whitespace before matching.
prompt:
Customers search for model numbers in messy formats: 'wh-1000xm5', 'WH1000-XM5', 'wh 1000 xm5'. Robust search normalizes punctuation and whitespace before matching.

Execute the required analytical SQL calculation in DuckDB.
Expected output columns: sku_id, raw_sku, product_title.
Row order does not matter.
golden_sql:
-- Cleanse search query 'wh1000xm5b' by stripping non-alphanumeric characters
            SELECT 
                sku_id,
                raw_sku,
                product_title
            FROM inventory_skus
            WHERE lower(regexp_replace(raw_sku, '[^a-zA-Z0-9]', '', 'g')) = lower(regexp_replace('wh 1000-xm5/b', '[^a-zA-Z0-9]', '', 'g'));
why_it_fails: Exact string equality misses 90% of technical product searches due to hyphens and spaces.
